lede: Monday night, Telluride Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and the property tax levy that funds it — and wrapped into that same meeting is a second reading on suspending the Open Space Fund's 5% RETT dedication for the year, a real tension between tight finances and the land-conservation commitments this town has made. The school board follows Tuesday with a debrief on November ballot results, including the MLO vote, which will shape district funding going forward. Ouray City Council is also deep in budget season, adopting four linked resolutions including their mill levy and 2027 fee schedule.
